<div class="mw-parser-output">
<p>The <b>Fixture campaign Z</b> was an invented campaign of 1986 and 1987, used only to exercise an import.<sup class="reference">[1]</sup></p>
<p>The campaign was caused by the Fixture event, 1969,<sup class="reference">[2]</sup> which had left the eastern road unheld for a year.</p>
<p>The garrison&#8217;s surrender in 1986&ndash;1987 was forced by the cam&shy;paign&#8217;s second advance along the eastern road.</p>
<h2>Prelude</h2>
<p>Following the Fixture event, 1900, the garrison withdrew and the roads were repaired at leisure.</p>
<p>The second advance was enabled by the Fixture event, 1969 and by the Fixture event, 1900 together, which this article names in one breath.</p>
<table class="infobox"><tr><td>A table nobody quotes, with the words eastern road in it.</td></tr></table>
</div>
